en: A stain appeared on the trousers.
why: register: брю́ки is the standard word, штаны́ the informal one

en: Experienced doctors work in the hospital.
why: register: врач is the profession, до́ктор the polite form of address

en: The salad with olives is very tasty.
why: different things: масли́ны are black olives, оли́вки green ones
мили́ция is the historical Russian force, поли́ция the current one
register: почему́ is everyday, отчего́ bookish
gender: учи́тельница is female, учи́тель unmarked
gender: подру́га is a female friend, прия́тель a male acquaintance
gender: учени́ца is a schoolgirl, учени́к unmarked
aspect and duration: поговори́ть is to have a talk, говори́ть simply to speak

en: I will sit down by the window.
why: присе́сть is to sit briefly, сесть to take a seat

en: She sat down on the bench.
why: same pair: присе́сть brief, сесть neutral
different verbs: беспоко́иться is to feel anxious, пережива́ть to go through something

en: He is nervous before the exam.
why: волнова́ться is agitation, не́рвничать unease

en: A long journey lies ahead of us.
why: different words entirely: впереди́ is an adverb of place, предстоя́ть a verb

en: We will set off in the morning.
why: дви́нуться is to start moving, отпра́виться to depart on a journey

en: I have no idea about this.
why: different words: име́ть against поня́тие — the sentences are built differently
different nouns: больно́й is the ill person, пацие́нт the one under treatment
different words: выпуска́ть against маши́на

en: Good morning! How did you sleep?
why: impersonal спало́сь against personal спа́ли

en: Hand in the work on time.
why: во́время is at the right moment, срок a fixed deadline
возвраща́ться is to return, приходи́ть to arrive on foot
секре́тный is officially classified, та́йный covert

en: The bank gave him a loan.
why: вы́дать is to issue formally, дать simply to hand over
рассле́дование is the official inquiry, сле́дствие the legal one
зря is pointlessly, напра́сно without result
дости́чь is to arrive at a level or result, доби́ться to win it after pressing for it
same pair: доби́ться is won after effort, дости́чь simply reached
register: креати́вный is the recent borrowing used of ideas and business, тво́рческий the native word for art
register: действи́тельность is the native bookish word, реа́льность the everyday borrowing
register: сде́латься is colloquial, стать the everyday word
same pair: де́латься is colloquial, станови́ться the everyday word

en: Now everything is clear to me.
why: поня́тно is understood by the hearer, я́сно evident in itself
register: вско́ре is bookish and relative to another event, ско́ро everyday and relative to now
и́стина is the abstract truth, пра́вда what really happened

en: They sell fresh vegetables at the market.
why: база́р is the open-air bazaar, ры́нок the standard word

en: This is an extremely important question.
why: register: кра́йне is the everyday intensifier, чрезвыча́йно formal
неве́рный is untrue, непра́вильный against the rules
register: зна́чить is everyday, означа́ть formal and used of signs and terms
